snippet.title: Solasta II - Early Access Date & Cast Reveal
snippet.description:
Wishlist Solasta II on Steam ahead of its launch into Early Access on March 12th, 2026: https://bit.ly/4903Qmt

This new look at Solasta II highlights the journey ahead for the Colwall siblings, whose lives are upended as they are pulled into an ancient conflict tied to the secrets their mother carried to her grave. Deorcas and Rickard, her biological children, find their fates entwined with the adopted siblings they grew up alongside, as forgotten powers awaken across the land of Neokos.

Voice Cast:
- Devora Wilde as Deorcas Colwall
- Ben Starr (BAFTA-nominated for Expedition 33) as Rickard Colwall
- Ellen Thomas as Anabasia
- Amelia Tyler (BAFTA-nominated for Hades II) as Shadwyn

Will you stay in the light? Or succumb to the whispers in the dark…

You can stay up to date on all the exciting updates for Solasta II here:
X - https://x.com/tct_adventures
Discord - https://discord.gg/SRY9Hv7mh9
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/tacticaladventures
BlueSky - https://bsky.app/profile/tactical-adventures.com
